correctness.rationale: The 48-element pair-block preserving subgroup S2 wr S3 is even-intersecting because each fixed block contributes 0 or 2 fixed points. Independent Python enumeration reconstructed the subgroup, all pairwise even agreement, and conjugacy-class sizes |(5,1)|=144 and |(3,2,1)|=120. The nonnegative central matrix W=3A_(5,1)+2A_(3,2,1) has degree 672, vanishes on family pairs, and its complete irreducible character-table spectrum has least eigenvalue -48. The eleven character rows yield dimension-squared total 720 and Hoffman inequality |F|≤720·48/(672+48)=48. The two verifier character evaluations were read as corroboration, not substituted for the representation-theoretic derivation.
